title: Date column definition raises `TypeError` since sqlalchemy `2.0.37`

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
### Describe the bug

After upgrading to sqlalchemy `2.0.37`, a simple ORM table definition involving `Date` columns results in an unexpected `TypeError`.
I can confirm that the bug also occurs with sqlalchemy `2.0.38`, but not `2.0.36` and below.

### Optional link from https://docs.sqlalchemy.org which documents the behavior that is expected

_No response_

### SQLAlchemy Version in Use

2.0.37

### DBAPI (i.e. the database driver)

psycopg2

### Database Vendor and Major Version

PostgreSQL 16

### Python Version

3.13

### Operating system

OSX

### To Reproduce

```python
from datetime import date
from sqlalchemy import Date
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase


class Base(DeclarativeBase): ...


class Test(Base):
    __tablename__ = "test"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(BigInteger, primary_key=True)
    date: Mapped[date] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=False)
```

### Error

```
ImportError while loading conftest '.../tests/conftest.py'.
tests/conftest.py:12: in <module>
    from ...
src/... in <module>
    class Test(Base):
.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/sqlalchemy/orm/decl_api.py:842: in __init_subclass__
    _as_declarative(cls._sa_registry, cls, cls.__dict__)
.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/sqlalchemy/orm/decl_base.py:244: in _as_declarative
    return _MapperConfig.setup_mapping(registry, cls, dict_, None, {})
.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/sqlalchemy/orm/decl_base.py:325: in setup_mapping
    return _ClassScanMapperConfig(
.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/sqlalchemy/orm/decl_base.py:572: in __init__
    self._extract_mappable_attributes()
.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/sqlalchemy/orm/decl_base.py:1568: in _extract_mappable_attributes
    value.declarative_scan(
.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/sqlalchemy/orm/properties.py:707: in declarative_scan
    self._init_column_for_annotation(
.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/sqlalchemy/orm/properties.py:747: in _init_column_for_annotation
    nullable = includes_none(argument)
.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/sqlalchemy/util/typing.py:574: in includes_none
    return type_ in (NoneFwd, NoneType, None)
.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/sqlalchemy/sql/elements.py:3946: in __bool__
    raise TypeError("Boolean value of this clause is not defined")
E   TypeError: Boolean value of this clause is not defined
``` 
